2 O.S.No.4507/2024
 Judgment On Preliminary Issue
 Additional Issue No.1
This suit is filed by the plaintiff against the defendants for permanent injunction and such other consequential reliefs.

Schedule Property:
 All that piece and parcel of the shop bearing Eshwar Roa vs Commissioner, Bbmp on 16 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/146635859/
1  No.1, "Ganesh Fast Food" situated at Abbigere,
 Bengaluru North Taluk, Bengaluru, measuring  East to West 10 feet and North to South 12 feet,
 in all measuring 120 sq.ft., RCC roof building and  bounded on:-
 East by : Shop No.2,
 West by : BBMP Property,
 North by : Road,
 South by : Vacant land.
2. The brief facts of the Plaintiff's case is as under:-

The plaintiff is the tenant under the ownership of Abbigere Municipality on a monthly rent of Rs.1,000/- and carrying a hotel business under the name and style "Ganesh Fast Food" and he has taken general license/
 3 O.S.No.4507/2024 permission to run the hotel from the president Abbigere Village Panchayath, Bengaluru North on 18.12.2006.
He is regularly paying rent to Abbigere Municipality and now it is comes under the BBMP.
The plaintiff has also paid 2 months rent to BBMP on October 2009 for a sum of Rs.2,000/- and also paid Rs.5,000/- vide receipt dated 18.07.2023.

The defendant No.2 refused to receive the rent as such the plaintiff was forced to send the total rent for a sum of Rs.12,000/- to the defendant No.1 by way of demand draft bearing No.323213 dated 19.06.2024 drawn on Canara Bank, Chikkabanavara, Bengaluru.

The defendant No.2 had issued a notice dated 27.05.2024,
calling upon the plaintiff to pay the rent and hand over possession of the suit schedule premises within 15 days.

Eshwar Roa vs Commissioner, Bbmp on 16 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/146635859/
2

The plaintiff has sent request letter dated 14.06.2024,
requesting the defendant No.2 to renew his tenancy in respect of the suit schedule property.

If the defendants not restrained by granting an order of permanent injunction, the plaintiff will be put to great injustice, loss and mental agony,
on the other hand defendants will not be put to any  4 O.S.No.4507/2024 hardship.
The cause of action for the suit arose on 27.05.2024 when the defendant No.2 caused notice demanding the plaintiff to handover vacant possession of the suit schedule property.
Hence, filed this suit.

3. The defendants appeared before the court through their counsel and filed written statement stating that the suit filed by the plaintiff in respect of schedule property is wholly false, frivolous and vexatious and same is not maintainable either in law or on facts.
The suit has been filed with an intention to harass the defendants and to coerce them to terms.
The plaintiff has suppressed all the real facts and mis-represented the same before this Court.
The plaintiff has not issued the statutory notice as required under Sec.482 of KMC Act or Sec.80(2) of CPC before filing the suit.

The defendants are denies the entire allegations made in the plaint and stated that the plaintiff is illegally occupied the suit schedule premises without obtaining the valid permission to run the shop from the BBMP authority and not entered the rental agreement with the BBMP and this is Eshwar Roa vs Commissioner, Bbmp on 16 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/146635859/
3  5 O.S.No.4507/2024 against the provisions of BBMP Act 2020 as a result, the BBMP has directed the plaintiff to vacate the suit schedule premises and hand over the possession to the BBMP.

As it is a property of BBMP following due process of law in the first instance has issued notice to the plaintiff on 27.05.2024, calling upon the plaintiff to pay the rent and hand over the possession of the suit schedule premises within 15 days.
Hence, prayed to dismiss the suit with exemplary costs.
4. Based on the said pleadings this Court framed as many as four Issues and one additional issue and among them Additional Issue No.1 is treated as preliminary issue.

The same is as under:-
 Additional Issue No.1:-
Whether
the  defendants No.1 and 2 proves that the  suit is not maintainable?
Issue No.4: What order or decree?
5. Heard both side.
Perused the case file.

6. My findings on the above issues are as under:
 Addl. Issue No.1 - In the Affirmative,
 Issue No.4 - As per final order, for the following:
 REASONS  7. PRELIMINARY ISSUE ADDL.
ISSUE NO.1:

This present suit is filed by the plaintiff against the defendants Eshwar Roa vs Commissioner, Bbmp on 16 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/146635859/
4 seeking the relief of permanent injunction restraining the defendant No.1 and 2, their agents, henchmen or the representatives or any other person/persons claiming under them from interfering with the plaintiff's peaceful possession and enjoyment of the suit schedule property and dispossessing him from the suit schedule property without due process of law and such other consequential reliefs.

8. The defendants on issuance of summons,
appeared represented by his counsel filed his written statement.

On filing of the written statement by defendant No.2 this Court has framed preliminary issue when this suit  7 O.S.No.4507/2024 for injunction against the defendant's authority not to disposes him is maintainable.
 9.
The plaintiff examined himself as P.W.1 and has got marked Ex.P.1 and 2.
Ex.P.1 is the license issued by BBMP valid till 21.07.2025.
In the said Ex.P.1 itself there is a note "Point No.1:- Application for renewal of Registration Certificate can be filed as early as 180 days prior to expiry date of Registration Certificate.

You can file application for renewal or modification of registration certificate by login into FSSAI's Food Safety Compliance System (https://foscos.fssai.gov.in) with your user id and password or call us at 1800112100 for any clarification."

Inspite of this, the plaintiff has not filed any renewal Eshwar Roa vs Commissioner, Bbmp on 16 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/146635859/
5 Registration Certificate to show that his license is renewed.
Then, in further Ex.P.2 is the document of rental receipts wherein those are the rental receipts from the year 2009 to 2012.
 10.
This is further as per the plaint averments, he has requested the defendant's authority to renew the  8 O.S.No.4507/2024 tenancy in respect of the suit schedule property.

However,
he has failed to produce any document to show that whether the defendant's authority renewed or given any notice.
Accordingly, he himself pleaded that prior to 15 days notice given by BBMP.

On 14.06.2024, inspite of vacating the suit schedule property or inspite of giving nay renewal license issued from BBMP he has filed this suit against the authority seeking the injunction from this Court to pass an order of injunction directing the defendant's authority not to dispossess him from the suit schedule premises.

Therefore, as the renewed license is not available and no documents to show that till 2025 he is the tenant and paying rent regularly, the plaintiff is not entitled to seek any order of injunction from this Court.

Therefore,
as sufficient materials are not produced by the plaintiff and he has failed to prove his case with cogent evidence, the same is not sufficient to prove his case.
Therefore, I hold this Additional Issue No.1 in the Affirmative.

 ORDER
The suit of the plaintiff is hereby dismissed with cost as not maintainable.
Draw decree accordingly.
